statements.text: I am so proud to have data centers in my rural community just south of Dallas. There was a lot of concern at the very beginning about what does this mean, this new technology, this new horizon of ours in technology and AI and everything that goes with it. I understand the fear of some of my colleagues on particularly the Eastern Seaboard, which is stretched thin with energy, power, and water and lines and so many other things. [...] This new technology gives them an opportunity to do so. They are doing so responsibly, with the cooperation of State and local governments.
statements.context: Chairman Ellzey delivers closing remarks at a House subcommittee hearing on rural investment in innovation, discussing the impact of AI-linked data centers on his Texas district.

statements.text: as the demand for AI accelerates, America's digital infrastructure is rapidly expanding into rural communities. [...] Our rural communities and small businesses are at the center of America's AI-driven growth. [...] keep us competitive with the AI race with China.
statements.context: Opening statement by the chairman at a House Subcommittee on Rural Development, Energy, and Supply Chains hearing on rural investment in AI infrastructure.
